subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` contract for `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, or should current parent-handoff behavior be documented and fixed without new config surface?
rationale: The issue requests new tool and config API surface, while current main already performs parent-session completion handoff by default but still has thread-bound completion gaps; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Approve narrow announceTarget contract
options.body: Add `announceTarget` with current-compatible defaults, keep ACP `streamTo` separate, and cover active, inactive, and thread-bound requester paths.

options.title: Canonicalize existing parent handoff
options.body: Do not add a new option; document current parent-session completion handoff and fix thread-bound suppressions under the existing behavior.

options.title: Defer to related handoff design
options.body: Pause this until structured callback and thread-context issues settle, then implement one consolidated completion-handoff contract.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow announceTarget contract
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` with current-compatible defaults, keep ACP `streamTo` separate, and cover active, inactive, and thread-bound requester paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original tool and already provided the clearest maintainer-facing acceptance shape for this issue.
